panditji.name: Pandit Ajay Sharma Ji
panditji.alias: Known among devotees as “Cycle Wala Panda”
panditji.bio: For over two decades, Pandit Ajay Sharma Ji has performed Vedic rituals on the sacred ghats of the Kshipra at Ujjain, a city devotees hold as one of the few places on earth where ancestral rites carry direct spiritual power. Trained in the Shradh Karma tradition of his family lineage, he is known locally as “Cycle Wala Panda” for the simple bicycle he once used to reach devotees across the ghat — a name that has stayed with him as a mark of humility even as families from across India and abroad now seek him out by name.

items.q: What is Pitra Dosh and how do I know if I have it?
items.a: Pitra Dosh occurs when ancestors' rites remain unfulfilled, often shown in a birth chart through affliction of the Sun or Saturn. Common signs include repeated family obstacles, delayed marriage, or unexplained health issues. A brief consultation with Pandit Ji can confirm this from your chart.

items.q: Why is Ujjain considered significant for Pitra Dosh Puja?
items.a: Ujjain sits on the banks of the Kshipra and is regarded in Vedic tradition as one of the most powerful sites for ancestral rites, alongside Gaya.

items.q: Can I book a puja without travelling to Ujjain?
items.a: Yes. We offer full online booking with live video streaming so you can witness the entire ritual remotely.

items.q: What is the difference between Tripindi Shradh and Narayan Bali?
items.a: Tripindi Shradh addresses incomplete rites across three generations of ancestors, while Narayan Bali specifically liberates souls who died through accident or unnatural causes.

items.q: How long does a typical Pitra Dosh Puja take?
items.a: Most Pitra Dosh rituals take between 3 to 5 hours depending on the specific procedure required.

items.q: Do I need to be present for Nag Bali Puja?
items.a: It is recommended but not mandatory. The ritual can be performed on your behalf with your Sankalp taken remotely.

items.q: What documents or details are needed to book?
items.a: We typically ask for the devotee's name, gotra, and the ancestor's details if known, along with your preferred date.

items.q: Is Prasad sent after the puja?
items.a: Yes, sacred prasad from the ritual is packaged and shipped to your address after completion.

items.q: How much does Pitra Dosh Puja cost?
items.a: Cost depends on the specific ritual and materials required. Pandit Ji will share a transparent breakdown during consultation.

items.q: What is Kaal Sarp Dosh and how is it treated?
items.a: Kaal Sarp Dosh forms when all planets fall between Rahu and Ketu in a chart. It is pacified through a dedicated puja combining mantra and offering at Ramghat.

items.q: Can international devotees book pujas?
items.a: Yes, we regularly perform rituals on behalf of NRI families across the US, UK, Canada, Australia and the Gulf.

items.q: What is Guru Chandal Dosh?
items.a: It forms when Jupiter and Rahu are conjunct in the birth chart, often affecting wisdom, decision-making and family guidance.

items.q: Is there a specific time of year best for Shradh rituals?
items.a: Pitru Paksha is considered most auspicious, though ancestral rites can be performed at other times when urgently needed.

items.q: What is Rudrabhishek and when should it be performed?
items.a: Rudrabhishek is a sacred bathing ritual of the Shivling, performed for health, protection and removal of obstacles, ideally on Mondays or during Shravan.

items.q: How do I choose between Mangal Dosh Puja and Navgraha Shanti?
items.a: Mangal Dosh Puja targets a specific Mars-related affliction, usually for marriage matters, while Navgraha Shanti addresses all nine planets broadly.

items.q: Can the puja be performed for a recently deceased family member?
items.a: Yes, specific Shradh rites are prescribed depending on how many days have passed since death; Pandit Ji will guide you on the correct procedure.

items.q: What should I wear or bring if I travel to Ramghat?
items.a: Simple, modest traditional attire is recommended. Pandit Ji's team arranges all ritual materials in advance.

items.q: Is Satyanarayan Katha only for special occasions?
items.a: It can be performed for any occasion of gratitude or new beginning, not only festivals — many families hold it annually.

items.q: How far in advance should I book?
items.a: We recommend booking at least one week ahead, particularly during Pitru Paksha when dates fill quickly.

items.q: How is payment handled for online bookings?
items.a: Payment can be made securely online after your consultation confirms the ritual and date; details are shared directly by our team.

sections.body: We collect the information you provide when booking a puja or contacting us — your name, phone number, email, address and ritual details — solely to arrange and perform your requested service.

sections.heading: How we use your information
sections.body: Your details are used to confirm bookings, share consultation updates, send prasad, and provide live video access where requested. We do not sell your information to third parties.

sections.heading: Data retention
sections.body: Booking records are retained only as long as necessary to provide our services and meet legal obligations.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For any privacy concerns, write to contact@cyclewalapanda.com.

By booking a puja through Pitra Dosh Puja, you agree that rituals are performed according to Vedic Shastra as interpreted by Pandit Ajay Sharma Ji and his team, at Ramghat, Ujjain, on the date and time confirmed at booking.

sections.heading: Bookings
sections.body: A booking is confirmed only after a consultation and written confirmation from our team. Dates during high-demand periods, such as Pitru Paksha, are allocated on a first-confirmed basis.

sections.heading: Rescheduling
sections.body: Requests to reschedule should be made at least 48 hours in advance wherever possible, subject to ghat and priest availability.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.body: While every ritual is performed with full sincerity and adherence to tradition, outcomes of a spiritual nature cannot be guaranteed.
Cancellations made at least 5 days before the scheduled puja are eligible for a full refund of advance payment, less any materials already procured for the ritual.

sections.heading: Late cancellations
sections.body: Cancellations within 48 hours of the scheduled ritual may not be eligible for a refund, as ghat arrangements and materials are booked in advance.

sections.heading: Rescheduling instead of cancelling
sections.body: In most cases we are happy to move your puja to a new date at no extra cost rather than process a cancellation — contact us as early as possible.

sections.heading: How refunds are processed
sections.body: Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method within 5–7 business days.
